camel_example: aliyun yike SubmitVideoCreativeGenerationJob --region cn-hangzhou --SceneType 'creator-sales' --AspectRatio '4:3' --AvatarData 'https://test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test.mp4' --WithSubtitles true --OutputLanguages CN --UserData 12374214127312673137132 --UserMaterials 'https://test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test.mp4' --JobParams 'TextType_:2,_TextContent_:_Today,_Beijing_held_a_press_conference_to_announce_plans_to_further_optimize_the_city_s_transportation_network,_including_adding_three_new_subway_lines_within_the_next_three_years...._,_AspectRatio_:_16:9_,_Resolution_:_720P_,_OutputLanguages_:_CN_,_YUE' --Resolution 720P --version 2026-07-07 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits a video creative generation job
description_zh: 提交一个视频创意生成作业
name: SubmitVideoCreativeGenerationJob

parameters.help_en:
The scene type. Valid values:
briefing-voiceover: news briefing (supplementary footage based on narration, no digital human).
creator-talk: creator explanation (multi-shot, news/science/finance).
creator-sales: creator marketing (three-segment, product promotion/review/store visit).
avatar-broadcast: digital human broadcast (fixed single shot, broadcast/announcement/template)
parameters.help_zh:
场景类型，可选：
briefing-voiceover，资讯播报（基于口播补充镜头画面/无数字人）
creator-talk，达人讲解（多分镜 · 资讯/科普/财经）
creator-sales，达人营销（三段式 · 带货/测评/探店）
avatar-broadcast，数字人播报（固定单镜 · 播报/公告/模板）
parameters.name: scene_type

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, and 3:4
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The output languages. Specify a JSON array converted to a string. Valid values: CN, EN, and YUE.
`avatar-broadcast` and `creator-sales` support only Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
输出语种，json array 转成string，可选 CN/EN/YUE
`avatar-broadcast`、`creator-sales`仅支持选择中文
parameters.name: output_languages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include subtitles. Default value: true
parameters.name: with_subtitles

parameters.help_en:
The list of user materials. This parameter contains the following fields:
MediaId: the media asset ID (an image or video uploaded to Wanjing Yike).
Type: the media type.
Action: the material usage method. Valid values: `match` (matching mode, which selects suitable segments from video materials based on narration) and `insert` (insertion mode, which inserts video materials before the CTA shot based on intelligent analysis after narration-based shot generation. This mode is valid only for videos). Default value: `match`
parameters.help_zh:
用户素材列表，包含字段：
MediaId：媒资ID（上传到万镜一刻的图片或视频）
Type：媒体类型
Action：素材使用方式，可选：`match`（匹配方式，基于口播选择视频素材中适合的片段）；`insert`（插入方式，选择视频素材插入CTA分镜前（基于口播生成分镜后智能分析），仅对视频有效）；默认 `match`
parameters.name: user_materials

parameters.help_en:
The digital human information. This parameter is required for the `creator-talk`, `creator-sales`, and `avatar-broadcast` scenes. This parameter contains the following fields:
AvatarPortrait: the digital human appearance. Required. String. The media asset ID or image URL of the portrait image.
AvatarVoice: the digital human voice. Optional. String. The voice audio ID or audio URL
parameters.help_zh:
数字人信息，`creator-talk`、`creator-sales`、`avatar-broadcast`场景必填，包含字段：
AvatarPortrait，数字人形象，必填，String，人像图片媒资 ID 或 图片URL
AvatarVoice，数字人音色，选填，String，人声音频ID或 音频URL
parameters.name: avatar_data

parameters.example: {\"TextType\":2,\"TextContent\":\"Today, Beijing held a press conference to announce plans to further optimize the city's transportation network, including adding three new subway lines within the next three years....\"}
parameters.help_en:
The job parameters. Specify a JSON string that contains the following fields:
TextType: Integer. Required. The text type. Valid values: 1 (raw content such as product or news information, which the system automatically converts to narration script) and 2 (narration script).
TextContent: String. Required. The text content. Maximum length: 10000 characters.
VoiceDuration: Integer. Optional. The expected narration duration. Set this field when TextType is set to 1. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60. The final video duration is slightly shorter than the expected duration.
NarrationVoiceId: String. The narration voice ID. This field is valid only for `briefing-voiceover`
parameters.help_zh:
任务参数，Json String，包含：
TextType，Integer，必填，文本类型，1-原始稿（商品或资讯信息，系统自动转为口播稿）；2-口播稿；
TextContent，String，必填，文本内容，最大长度10000字符
VoiceDuration，Integer，选填，预期口播时长，当TextType==1时设置，单位：秒，默认60s，最终成片会略少于预期时长
NarrationVoiceId，String，旁白音色ID，仅对`briefing-voiceover`有效
parameters.name: job_params

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string. The custom parameters. The value is returned as-is in query and callback results. Maximum length: 8192. System reserved word fields:
NotifyAddress: the callback URL (must start with http(s)://, maximum length: 2048). The callback is triggered after the node reaches a desired state.
UserId: the UID of the actual resource ownership. If this field is not specified, the value falls back to CallerUid
parameters.help_zh:
JSON String，自定义参数，查询/回调结果原样携带，最大长度 8192。系统保留字段：
NotifyAddress：回调地址 URL（须 http(s)://，最大 2048），任务终态后回调
UserId：真实资源归属 uid（缺失时回落 CallerUid）
parameters.name: user_data

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the task is in the Failed state
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，Failed 状态下返回
